# Index Rebuild Search — index rebuild + search integration

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write rebuild-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/rebuild-note.md'

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write second-rebuild-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/second-rebuild-note.md'

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write rebuild-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

# --- Search works before rebuild ---

exec akb search 'microservices'
stdout 'notes/rebuild-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

# --- Rebuild index (both index.md and SQLite) ---

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

# --- Search still works after rebuild ---

exec akb search 'microservices'
stdout 'notes/rebuild-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

# --- Index show reflects rebuilt content ---

exec akb index show
stdout 'Rebuild Search Note'
stdout 'Second Rebuild Note'
stdout 'Rebuild Search Decision'

# --- Rebuild after deleting a page ---

exec akb delete notes/rebuild-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/rebuild-note.md'

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

# --- Search no longer finds deleted page ---

exec akb search 'microservices'
! stdout 'notes/rebuild-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

# --- Index show no longer has deleted page ---

exec akb index show
! stdout 'Rebuild Search Note'
stdout 'Second Rebuild Note'
stdout 'Rebuild Search Decision'

# --- Rebuild restores search after DB corruption ---

# Simulate DB corruption by removing search.db
exec rm .akb/search.db

! exec akb search 'microservices'
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

# Rebuild creates fresh search.db
exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

exec akb search 'microservices'
stdout 'decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

# --- Link graph also rebuilt after index rebuild ---

exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/second-rebuild-note.md'

# --- Core I/O still works after rebuild ---

exec akb read notes/second-rebuild-note.md
stdout 'Second Rebuild Note'

exec akb list
stdout 'notes/second-rebuild-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 2'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Rebuild Search Note
summary: Note for rebuild-search integration
tags: rebuildsearch
---
This note discusses microservices architecture patterns.

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Second Rebuild Note
summary: Another note for rebuild-search
tags: rebuildsearch
---
Content about event-driven architecture and messaging.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Rebuild Search Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for rebuild-search testing
tags: [rebuildsearch]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

We chose microservices for our system architecture. A rebuild walks the filesystem and re-derives the index and the search database from the page bodies, so every indexed term has to come from the body itself. See [[rebuild-note]] for the note that carries the same terms.

## Decision

Decided. The decision keeps the words microservices and architecture in its body so the rebuild finds them again.

## Consequences

Recorded. After a rebuild the decision is searchable by the same query as before.
